raw_text: At approximately 09:15 the driver reported unusual vibration from the rear bogie while approaching the station. The train was brought to a controlled stop at the platform for inspection. Maintenance staff examined the wheel assembly and found a worn brake pad. A replacement part was sourced from the depot and fitted within 40 minutes. The train resumed service after a final safety check by the duty engineer.
